finding.message: User-supplied target_ip is interpolated into a shell command string executed with shell=True.
answers: target_ip is embedded into a shell command via f-string: f'ping -c 1 {target_ip}'.
No shell metacharacter escaping or input validation is performed.
subprocess.run(..., shell=True) is the sink executing the constructed command.
Attacker supplies '127.0.0.1; rm -rf /' to execute arbitrary OS commands.
